name: secret_check
exceptional_convention: normal stack; level-transition secret interval bookkeeping only

name: thief_end_dodge
exceptional_convention: normal stack; if an active dodge exists, clears mode bit 3, toggles low mode bits 0/1, and repairs the next route cell

name: thief_begin_dodge
exceptional_convention: normal stack; if an active non-dodging thief exists, sets mode bit 3, toggles low mode bits 0/1, and repairs the next route cell

name: thief_track_victim_move
exceptional_convention: normal stack; updates only when player_index is the current thief victim and the packed position changed

name: thief_find_aligned_shooter
exceptional_convention: normal stack; scans active player MOBs whose shot direction is opposite thief direction and whose wrapped position lies exactly on that shot ray

name: secret_code_build
exceptional_convention: frameless; uses global name/state buffers and preserves D2

name: secret_getname
exceptional_convention: normal stack; global winner/settings state; either initializes name entry or marks the winner complete and clears trick_player
